question: Into how many parts is the span from finial to upper beam divided?
premises: A span from finial end to upper beam is considered.
This span is subjected to division.
inference: The span from the finial end to the upper beam is to be divided into six parts.
uncertainties: The compound sthūpyantamuttarādyaṃ may have a specific technical architectural meaning.
plain_english: And when the span from the finial end to the upper beam is divided, it is divided into six parts.
